method: Every accent value below was established from EVIDENCE gathered off the brand's own served bytes,
not from memory. Three probes produced it (all in this directory, all re-runnable):
probe-evidence.mjs      — CSS custom properties named brand/accent/primary/cta, header logo SVG fills,
probe-frequency.mjs     — every saturated hex in HTML + CSS + JS chunks, frequency-ranked, plus a
hit-count for each hypothesised brand hex (hypothesis -> confirmed on real bytes).
probe-builder-theme.mjs — the site builder's own theme settings: Squarespace --accent-hsl, Shopify
--color-button-primary-background, and the rule that actually paints the CTA.
THE FAVICON IS NEVER A TRUTH SOURCE HERE. The favicon is the signal the fixer is about to start using;
deriving truth from it would make the truth set agree with the fix by construction. Same reason no truth
Where two defensible answers existed and they were far enough apart to change a band, the row is excluded
as `unknown` rather than guessed — a wrong truth value is worse than a missing one.

fields.accent: hex, or null when the correct answer is NO ACCENT (achromatic brand)
fields.achromatic: true means 'returned no accent' is a HIT and 'invented a colour' is a MISS
fields.confidence: high = named brand token / logo SVG fill / overwhelming frequency; medium = one good source, or a live conflict noted
